ios.desc:
Your network starts here.

No CS degree means no classmates, no alumni and no coworkers. If you taught yourself to code and build things with AI on your own, nobody hands you a network. You just don't have one.

Reddit, X and Discord give you comments, not conversations. You ask something, get a few one-line replies from strangers, and never hear from them again. You can't go deep with someone you'll never speak to twice.

Neonetworking is built the other way around. Each week you're matched with a few developers building what you're building. You talk in private 1:1 chats or small groups of four. The same people, week after week — you become each other's network.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Talk through what you're stuck on with someone who's been there
• Share what you're building and get honest feedback from outside your bubble
• Compare notes on tools, pricing, first users, and what AI-written code does at scale
• Find collaborators, from anywhere in the world

HOW IT WORKS
• Tell us what you're working on: web development, app development, UI/UX design, startup ideas and validation, marketing and growth — and your level in each
• Building software? Add how you build: traditional coding, vibe coding or no-code
• Add what you're looking for, and whether you'd rather talk 1:1 or in a group of four
• Each week you get up to three suggested people and one group of four, with a short note on what you have in common
• A 1:1 chat opens only when both of you accept. A group opens as soon as one person joins
• New suggestions arrive every Monday. Chats you've already started stay open — the weekly reset never closes them
• No feed, no followers, nothing to scroll
• Something not working, or have an idea? Send feedback from Settings

SAFETY AND PRIVACY
• For adults only: you must be 18 or older
• Report someone or a specific message in a few taps. A person reviews every report
• Block anyone, at any time. They aren't told
• Leave a chat or a group whenever you want
• Photos from other people stay blurred until you tap to see them
• Messages with language that isn't allowed are refused, not sent
• Only your country is shown on your profile, never your city
• Delete your account from inside the app at any time

Free. Available in 18 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese (Brazil), Hindi, Russian, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Turkish, Italian, Polish, Swahili and Amharic.
